result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues where content is cut off and not fully visible to the user.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side of the screen, making the full card content not visible
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scrolling container or card sizing to ensure all cards are fully visible or implement a horizontal scroll indicator to show there's more content to the right

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the screen, with only the promotional tag '-100%' and partial image visible, but restaurant name and details are hidden
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper spacing/padding at the bottom of scrollable sections or adjust card heights so that complete restaurant information is visible without requiring scrolling to see the card details
